Hello everyone.
This mod is for children to talk, go to school, have daily activities, give gifts and get invites to go to the movies.
The reason I made this mod was because I wanted to make my children seem alive.
Donate : PayPal.Me/mindnattaphorn

*** P.S. I'm not a native speaker. If there is anything wrong, bug or wrong words, please send to this email --->  alizsabeth46@gmail.com ***


Child Age Up 
Featuer
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Add portraits and sprites to your child with many designs as parents.[/size]
[*][size=3]Add schedules to go to school with Jas and Vincent.[/size]
[*][size=3]Add schedules for normal day.[/size]
[*][size=3]Add dialogue for normal daily routine during the festival (not in festival), dialogue in each season, and when receiving gifts.[/size]
[*][size=3]Add child's outfit will change depending on the season.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Requirements
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15152]LittleNpcs[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][size=3]

How to Install
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Download and extract the file to Stardew Valley\Mods (Mods folder)[/size]
[/list][size=3]

Caution[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If you use another mod of this type (changes the schedule, character/portrait, or dialogue of the children) please remove the other mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]There may be errors when your child enters the house.[/size]
[*][size=3]Cannot be used in multiplayer systems because of character loads. Farmhands loading into a map with the custom children will fall out of the world.[/size]
[/list][size=3]

Bugs/Issuesthat are not yet resolved
[/size][list]
[*][size=3] If the 1st or 2nd child has grown up(As atoddler) and the mod has not changed them, please make sure that you have set[/size]
[*][size=3]---> StardewValley\Mods\ChildToNPC\config.json   "AgeWhenKidsAreModified" from  ‘83’ to ‘56’.﻿﻿ If you havechanged this, but the children are still unaffected, try reopening the game.There[/size]
[size=3]is a chance that some days the children will not go out according to their
routines.[/size][*][size=3]For now, the dialogue for beforegoing to the cinema and after leaving the cinema is still broken.[/size]
[*][size=3]It may happen that in some instances a child stands in front of the door.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
ConfigurationOptions
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]You can choose a sprite and portrait for each child by going toconfig.json(in notepad) and changing "Auto" from "True" to[/size]
[size=3]"False"[/size][*][size=3]After that, it canbe changed from the "default" to another name, such as[/size]
[size=3]"abigail". Enter the names in lower case only to prevent errors.[/size][*][size=3]You can set thecurfew for your children in the folder of ChildToNPC at config.json the[/size]
[size=3]original value is 1900 (1900 meaning 7pm.)[/size][*][size=3]There are 2 types of dresses,apron style and no apron style. If you wantno apron, change   "Apron"  from  "True"   to  "False".[/size]
[*][size=3]To change the coat color, go toconfig.json in the Child Age Up folder and you will see the word[/size]
[size=3]"MaleCoatColor" (boy coat color) and "FemaleCoatColor"
(girl coat color) and change the color value (Original values are black and
white) with the following options: black, blue, bluesky, brown, green, magenta,
pink, purple, red, white, yellow and then save.
[/size][/list][size=3]
Other
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Able to support parents is Abigail, Alesia, Alex, Elliott, Emily, Haley, Harvey, John, Leah, Lyell, Maru, Olivia, Penny, Raphtalia, Sam, Sandy, Sebastian, Shane, Sophia, Sorren, Victor and Wizard. (Alesia cannot be used as a parent, But if you like this design you can use it)[/size]
[/list][size=3]

[/list][size=3]

ข้อควรรู้

[size=3]---> Stardew Valley\Mods\ChildToNPC\config.json     [i]"[/i]AgeWhenKidsAreModified"  จาก  83   เปลี่ยนเป็น  56 หากลองทำตามแล้วแต่ยังไม่เปลี่ยน ให้ลองออกและเข้าเซฟใหม่[/size][*][size=3]มีโอกาสอยู่บ้าง ที่ลูกจะไม่ออกไปทำตามกิจวัตรประจำวันของตัวเอง[/size]
[*][size=3]ขณะนี้บทพูดของลูกก่อนเข้าโรงหนังและออกจากโรงหนังยังใช้งานไม่ได้[/size]
[*][size=3]สามารถเลือกภาพขณะพูดและชุดเสื้อผ้าของลูกขณะเดินได้ที่ config.json ของตัวโฟล์เดอร์มอดได้เลย หากต้องการเปลี่ยนให้ไม่เหมือนพ่อหรือแม่ เปลี่ยน  "Auto"  จาก "True"  เป็น  "False"  แล้วค่อยเปลี่ยนคำจาก "default" ให้เป็นชื่อตัวละครตัวอื่นแทน เช่น "abigail" (พิมพ์ตัวเล็กเพื่อป้องกันความผิดพลาด)[/size]
[*][size=3]สามารถเปลี่ยนเวลาที่ลูกจะกลับบ้านได้ที่โฟลเดอร์ ChildToNPC  ที่  config.json เวลาปกติอยู่ที่ 1900 (1900 หมายถึง 1 ทุ่ม)[/size]
[*][size=3]ชุดลูกมี 2 แบบคือแบบใส่เอี๊ยมและแบบไม่ใส่ หากไม่ใส่ ให้เปลี่ยน   "Apron"  จาก "True"  เป็น  "False"[/size]
